correctness.rationale: Proved endpoint vector cyclic for path adjacency, with characteristic/minimal polynomial p_n(z)=z^(h−1)g_u(z)^(2h), g_u squarefree. In B=A_n⊗I+I⊗A_n, equal-root sectors only yield zero eigenvalues. For the nonzero roots e=2h, Frobenius change z=x+y in K[x,y]/(x^e,y^e) gives e chains length e. For the zero root e=h−1, z^h=0, and h−2 independent vectors z^(h−1)x^j force h−2 chains length h, leaving J1. Fitting kernels yield d_t, sharp time and population; summing block counts n recovers known single-step nullity. Independent direct binary-grid rank checks of 72 cases; no extrapolation from those finite cases.

value.rationale: The exact all-n 2-adic transition profile is a natural complete dynamical invariant for boundary-dependent cellular automata, adding all finite-time kernel sizes and first-entrance probabilities to established rank-one kernel results; families n=2^a−1 exhibit sharp nilpotent extinction.
residual_risks: A deeper pre-existing Chebyshev theorem might make this an unrecorded corollary, but no decisive covering implication was found.

final_claim: Every n>=2 open n-by-n square-grid neighbor-sum update over finite characteristic-two field has zero-primary Jordan partition J2^(u−1) for h=1, or J1+Jh^(h−2)+J2h^(h(u−1)) for h=2^ν2(n+1)>=2, u=(n+1)/h, and exact first-periodic-entry counts q^(R+d_t).
limitations: Only square open grids n>=2 over characteristic-two finite fields; no nonsquare rectangle, shifted Lights Out, or primitive recurrent period classification.
Relevant Sutner/Hunziker source full texts remain uninspected.
